name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Hudson County Summer Camp
operator_name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Hudson County
description_short: Full day summer camp at the Boys & Girls Clubs in Jersey City and Hoboken, 7:30 AM to 6 PM with bus service. Rising STARs serves kindergarten to grade 3 with literacy, science, healthy living and play; the grade 4 to 8 camp mixes weekly educational and fun field trips with clubhouse enrichment, fitness and arts.
notes: Two clubhouses: Jersey City Club, 225 Morris Boulevard, and Edward A. Dalton Club, 123 Jefferson Street, Hoboken (201-963-6443). Buses pick up from 8 AM and leave the club at 5 PM. Pricing is by phone only; the club notes membership is no or very low cost thanks to funders, and families in Jersey City Housing Authority developments or with Urban League co-pays are flagged on the form. Children must complete a Boys & Girls Club membership application with proof of income or benefits. A separate Teen Tech Camp serves ages 13 to 18.
